label: Finding-90
title: openai-same-day: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: OpenAI's own framing differs from 'independently, same day': Cybernews relays OpenAI: 'Calif used GPT-5.6 Sol to investigate the flaw. OpenAI's own researcher subsequently identified additional flaws'. The Foundation says OpenAI independently reported the same root cause on 11 August. Both may be true (same root cause on day one, more vectors on 18 September), but the site should show OpenAI's own framing.
